text.p: These are the leading stories in Botswana's independent midweek newspaper, The Gazette, on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A group of Japanese investors told Minister of Commerce and Industry George Kgoroba it was unlikely they would be putting any of their money into Botswana because of high wages and little indigenous business enterprise.
- Former police commissioner Simon Hirschfeldt has dismissed allegations by a former South African police officer, Joe Mamasela, that he was in the pay of South African 'Vlakplaas' operatives.
